question: Are you married or about to be married?
How many children do you have?
Was the child born via normal delivery or Operation(C-section), and at how many months?
Did the child have to be admitted to the NICU after birth?
Was there excessive bleeding from the umbilical cord, or did it take more than 3 weeks to fall off?
After receiving the BCG vaccine, did anything unusual happen at the injection site, such as severe swelling or an abscess?
Were the child's hearing and vision tests normal at birth?
Does the child have a cleft lip or cleft palate?
Has the child experienced seizures (fits) or delayed developmental milestones?
Has the color of the child's lips, fingers, or toes ever turned blue?
Is the child's abdomen gradually enlarging, or has a doctor noted an enlarged liver and spleen?
Has the child ever required a blood transfusion?
Has a doctor ever told you that your hemoglobin/blood levels are low or high?
Did the child experience joint swelling and pain while walking or playing that resolved on its own after some days or weeks?
Was there excessive bleeding after losing a milk tooth, or does the child bruise easily?
Do the child's private parts appear unusual?
Does the child have swellings or lumps on their body since birth?
Has the child been hospitalized repeatedly?
Has the child suffered from frequent infections requiring intravenous (IV) antibiotics?
Does the child's urine or stool have an unusual or strange odor?
Was the child fine at birth but suddenly fell seriously ill later, requiring emergency care?
Are the child's body parts disproportionate, such as very short limbs compared to the torso?
Is the child's thumb or any other finger missing or unusually small?
Is your child growing at the same rate as other children?
Does the child experience frequent pain in their joints and limbs?
Does the child have silvery hair?
When the child is sick, misses a meal, or eats specific foods, do they become very lethargic, vomit frequently, or have seizures?
Does the child have any kidney disease?
Have signs of puberty (such as pubic hair, breast development, or deepening voice) appeared earlier than usual in the child?
Have signs of puberty failed to begin by the expected age?
Were there any complications during pregnancy, such as high blood pressure, diabetes, or thyroid issues?
Was a thalassemia screening performed for both the mother and the father, and what was the result?
Did you have a sonography scan during pregnancy, and was it normal?
Did the doctor report any heart defects during pregnancy scans or at birth?
Did you require a blood transfusion during pregnancy?
Did the delivery occur without any complications?
Were you and your spouse blood relatives (such as cousins or from the same family) before marriage?
Have you experienced any miscarriages or abortions?
Has any child in the family passed away before one year of age, and if so, what was the reason?
Does anyone in the family suffer from seizures, developmental delays, or loss of acquired milestones?
Does anyone in the family suffer from blindness?
Does anyone in the family have partial or complete hearing loss?
Does anyone in the family require blood transfusions?
Does anyone in the family have a history of excessive bleeding disorders?
Has any child or family member been diagnosed with cancer?
Does anyone in the family have heart or kidney disease?
Has anyone in the family experienced early-onset high blood pressure, high cholesterol, or a stroke?
In the mother's family, is there a history of bleeding disorders, recurrent infections, or dry, itchy skin patches (eczema)?
Does anyone else in the family have the exact same health issue as your child?
